title: Sum of noisy influences
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $\rho\in\mathbb R$. Then $\sum_iI_i^{(\rho)}(f)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}|S|\rho^{|S|-1}\widehat f(S)^2$, using natural powers.
hypotheses_covered: arity n and a Boolean function f : {0,1}^n → ℝ
a real noise rate ρ (no constraint imposed)
right-hand sum over all subsets S ⊆ [n]
